newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins little changed, eye FOMC meeting.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins little changed, eye FOMC meeting.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were little changed in thin trading on Monday, with the market put on hold by a possible interest rate hike on Tuesday, dealers said.
On May 20 the U.S. policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee meets and could raise U.S. interest rates.

"Just a few client deals were struck through brokers and nothing else happened. To open new positions now, is like playing in a casino, betting on red or black," National Reserve Bank dealer Andrei Ivanov-Golitsyn said.
Results of a preliminary Reuters poll show that U.S. experts are equally divided over whether the Fed will maintain policy as it stands, or hike rates by 25 basis points.
Dealers said price moves in each tranches were mixed and depended on individual investors, with the whole emerging debt market waiting on the sidelines for the meeting.
MinFins with other emerging debt are sensitive to any news which would suggest a further rise in U.S. interest rates, as this would push down U.S. Treasury bond prices.
